notes.title: Game Update - Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Patch 1.01 - Minor update

After feedback from some players, we made the following updates:

- Modified crosshair image for better viewing.
- Added option to disable the background and have a better viewing (bye bye matrix effect :( )
- Halved the effects of lights. If you already have the game installed it is recommended to go to the options menu and adjust the lights in a way that is pleasing to your eyes.


Thanks to everyone who bought our game. Continue send your feedback to further improve ShapeNeon Chaos!

notes.title: Beta Update 2 - Time Attack mode
notes.notes:
Today in Beta update, we added a new play mode: "Time Attack"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39567146/18b2a314450cf9bfdfa97edfcd39866988e3f1a4.png[/img]

Start with just 1 life and 1 bomb (you can gain more each 2:30 minutes)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39567146/163d894975148b2e3c5d59eff8beb45654a26b70.png[/img]

In this mode there is no score, you have to survive as long as you can

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39567146/5aadf4db7114e10de766e636bc481cde3a505a5b.png[/img]

In this mode there is no high score, you have to beat the best time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39567146/7b4607727446afd5bf55fda075092dfb9f4e53a2.png[/img]


Add the game to your WishList to get ready to launch !
